authority: Owner delegated the final verdict on these 11 scans to the AI review ('take a hard multi angle look at them, and give the verdict'). Verdicts are AI-adjudicated (annotator claude-vision-ai-v1), not human-verified.
lands_rule: A line lands only if it lies on a real formed press-brake fold, parallel to it, and covers >= ~80% of the fold's visible length. Hole walls, thickness/perimeter edges, embosses, gentle kinks (< ~20 deg over a large radius) and scan artifacts are not bends.

results.reason: 12 formed folds all land (88-99% coverage). B12 is a 15 deg window tab cut free on 3 sides with a localized ~8-10 mm radius (20-50 mm radii rejected), and the sibling V scan has the same tab, so it is a formed bend, not a gentle kink. The 135 deg wall corners are butt seams or V-relief notches, not folds.
